test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 02 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A trader marked his goods at 12% above the cost price. He sold half the stock at the marked price, one quarter at a discount of 12% on the marked price and the rest at a discount of 30% on the marked price. His total gain is:
solution:
Given:

Marked price (MP) = 12% above cost price (CP)

Sold half the stock at MP

Sold one-quarter at 12% discount on MP

Sold one-quarter at 30% discount on MP

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

**Calculation:**

Let CP = 100

Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 12% of 100

⇒ MP = 100 + 12

⇒ MP = 112

Selling half at MP:

⇒ SP₁ = 112 × 1/2

⇒ SP₁ = 56

Selling one quarter at a discount of 12% on MP:

⇒ SP₂ = 112 × (1 - 0.12) × 1/4

⇒ SP₂ = 112 × 0.88 × 1/4

⇒ SP₂ = 24.64

Selling the rest at a discount of 30% on MP:

⇒ SP₃ = 112 × (1 - 0.30) × 1/4

⇒ SP₃ = 112 × 0.70 × 1/4

⇒ SP₃ = 19.6

Total SP:

⇒ Total SP = SP₁ + SP₂ + SP₃

⇒ Total SP = 56 + 24.64 + 19.6

⇒ Total SP = 100.24

Total gain:

⇒ Gain = Total SP - CP

⇒ Gain = 100.24 - 100

⇒ Gain = 0.24

Gain percentage:

⇒ Gain % = (Gain / CP) × 100

⇒ Gain % = (0.24 / 100) × 100

⇒ Gain % = 0.24%

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
